13 NOVEMBER: My Birthday

RULES

Chaos Sudoku

Rows, columns, and regions must each contain the digits 1-9 exactly once.

Regions

The 9 regions are hidden and must be determined by shading. Every region is orthogonally connected.

Arrows

The digit in an arrow cell indicates the number of consecutive cells immediately following it in the direction of the arrow that belong to the same region as the arrow cell. Every arrow cell must belong to a different region from one another.

🎁

Gift Box

This acts as a killer cage: digits within a cage must sum to the given total, and digits may not repeat within a cage.

Region separation (Gift Box)

No two cells within the same gift box cage may belong to the same region.

White Balloon

Digits separated by a white balloon (kropki dot) are consecutive.

Black Balloon

Digits separated by a black balloon (kropki dot) have a 1:2 ratio.

Region separation (Balloon)

Any two cells connected by a balloon (kropki dot) must belong to different regions, regardless of the dot's color.

XV

XV

Digits separated by X sum to 10, digits separated by V sum to 5.

Negative diagonals

Digits may not repeat on both positive and negative diagonals.

NOV

13 NOVEMBER

Every cell in 13 NOVEMBER row belongs to a different region from one another.
